# origincloud_secret_manager_secrets (Data Source)

Lists a project's secrets in a region, ordered by name, without any payload. Deleted ones are listed only when `show_deleted` is set, so a page may hold fewer secrets than `page_size` and still be followed by another. Needs `secretmanager.secret.list` on the project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "origincloud_secret_manager_secrets" "all" {
  project = "my-project-123"
  region  = "eu-central1"
}

# The secrets of one team.
output "billing_secrets" {
  value = [for s in data.origincloud_secret_manager_secrets.all.secrets : s.name if try(s.tags.team, "") == "billing"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) The project whose secrets to list.
- `region` (String) The region whose secrets to list.

### Read-Only

- `secrets` (Attributes List) The secrets listed, from every page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--secrets))

<a id="nestedatt--secrets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `secrets`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String) When the secret was created. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `delete_time` (String) When the secret was deleted; unset unless it is `DELETED`. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `expire_time` (String) When a deleted secret is destroyed with its versions, and its id becomes free; unset unless it is `DELETED`. RestoreSecret is refused after it. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `id` (String) The secret's full resource name, `//secretmanager.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/secrets/{secret}`: what an argument that refers to the secret takes. `name` is the relative name, without the host.
- `kms_key` (String) The full name of the KMS key every payload of the secret is encrypted under, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`: an `ENCRYPT_DECRYPT` key of the secret's own project and region. Left out on CreateSecret, it is the project's default Secret Manager key in the region: a key the platform creates in your project with its first secret there that names no key, tagged `origin:name=secretmanager` and marked `platform_managed`, which you see in your KMS key list and audit log but can't change or delete. A key of another project or region, or a signing key, is refused with `BAD_REQUEST`. It can't be changed after the secret is created. While the key is disabled or deleted, AddSecretVersion and AccessSecretVersion are refused with `CONFLICT` naming it; once it is enabled again, they succeed again.
- `name` (String) The secret's resource name, `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/secrets/{secret}`. Its last segment is the `secret_id` given to CreateSecret.
- `state` (String) Whether the secret is in use or scheduled for deletion. One of `ACTIVE`, `DELETED`.
- `tags` (Map of String) Labels of your own, at most 50. The `origin:name` tag is the name the console shows. Tags aren't secret: never put a secret value in one.
- `update_time` (String) When the secret last changed. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
